tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. The default ground for all text tokens.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on paper: today's lesson card, answer options, ask box answers, inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and quiet fills: skeletons while text is being written, the week strip on Stats, hover on rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the masthead double rule, control borders, and the fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, upcoming steps, helper text. Passes 4.5:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary buttons, the selected answer marker).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and sections. Never the only border of a control: controls use ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Vermilion. Kickers and labels, the current-step underline, the streak number, focus rings. Used sparingly: at most one or two marks per screen.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Ink blue for a correct answer, a passed Mastery Check and completed status. Always paired with a check glyph and the word Correct or Passed.

tokens.name: correct-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a correct answer option after reveal. Text on it uses correct or ink.

tokens.name: incorrect
tokens.usage: Burnt orange for a wrong answer, a failed check and generation errors. Always paired with a cross glyph and a word. Blue versus orange keeps the pair apart for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: incorrect-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a wrong answer option after reveal, and of inline error notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Learn one thing well, every day.
styles.usage: Landing headline at desktop. Steps down to 52px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Moments: the finish screen, Mastery Check result, the streak on Stats.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Lesson and series titles. Wraps freely: AI titles can run long.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.sample: Which year was a leap year?
styles.usage: Questions in recall, checks and tests.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Earth takes about 365.2422 days to circle the Sun, not a neat 365.
styles.usage: Lesson paragraphs at tablet and desktop. Measure capped at 64ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Earth takes about 365.2422 days to circle the Sun, not a neat 365.
styles.usage: Lesson paragraphs on phones, and general body copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: One question from an earlier lesson.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Answers come from this lesson. Nothing is saved.
styles.usage: Asides and reassurance. Italic is the voice of the margin.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers, step names, status labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and link-button text. Sentence case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between an answer option's marker and text, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs in short copy, card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter and hero breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: buttons, cards, inputs, options. The Almanac is square.

tokens.name: radius-hairline
tokens.usage: Only the tiny answer marker box, so it reads as a checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only round things: avatars and the day dots on the streak strip.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Rules between rows and sections, in the rule colour.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Control outlines (secondary buttons, inputs, options), in ink.

tokens.name: border-masthead
tokens.usage: The heavy top line of the masthead double rule and the current-step underline.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus, option selection.

tokens.name: duration-step
tokens.usage: Moving between session steps and revealing feedback.

tokens.name: duration-moment
tokens.usage: The finish moment and the Mastery Check pass. Used at most once per screen.
